stem: Leela tests 2178 for divisibility by 11 using alternating digit sums, starting from the units digit.

options.text: $2 + 1 + 7 + 8 = 18$, so check divisibility by 9 instead for the 11 test.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice that uses alternating place values.

part_answers.answer: Place values alternate between 1 more and 1 less than a multiple of 11, so an alternating digit sum of 0 shows divisibility by 11.

teacher.key_rationale: Alternating from units: 8-7+1-2=0, so 2178 is divisible by 11. Digit sum for 9 is a different test. Same-sign summing to 18 is not the 11 rule.
